sloka: स्वराज्ये वस लङ्कायां मया दत्ते विभीषण ।न त्वां धर्षयितुं शक्ताः सेन्द्रा अपि दिवौकसः ।। ६.१२५.१८ ।।
transliteration: svarājye vasa laṅkāyāṁ mayā datte vibhīṣaṇa ।na tvāṁ dharṣayituṁ śaktāḥ sendrā api divaukasaḥ ।। 6.125.18 ।।

translations.english: After Rama had spoken that way Sugriva, Vibheeshana, monkeys and Rakshasas saluted Rama and said as follows.
